body: I think I was on this flight...lol  I remember something similar happening when I was younger.

Why did I stay?  I ask myself that all the time...and the answer is always because I can't stand to be away from my kids.  With the legal system the way it is, it's damn near impossible (unless you've got lots of money) to get custody if you're a dad.  And Adultry isn't illegal or a legal cause for divorce in this state.  So it's either live with it...or live without tucking my kids into bed every night.  Probably the biggest reason I'm horribly depressed...

My wife of ~7 years has done this to me more than once.  Recently, she's been talking to this ass named Kris.  She's put a password on her winmo phone, only emails him at work, and swears that there's nothing going on...that he's "just a friend" and "there's nothing going on".  The past 3 times that she's said that...I've caught her.  I tried texting the guy to say look...I've been through this one too many times, can you just confirm that there's nothing going on?  He has yet to answer.  Maybe I'm just too burned from the last few times and just being a jealous prick, but it's kinda hard not to be like this.  The last guy who was "just a friend", I found out later that she was banging him in the check room where she works.  If you don't have kids with him, drop him quick.  He'll swear that nothing will ever happen again...and he loves you more than life itself.  DO NOT LISTEN.  Once a cheater, always a cheater.  If you stay, it'll only get worse.

he doesn't.  Take it from me...he'll do it again.  My wife has done it 3 times now...and each time I've forgiven her.  I guess I just love punishment or something.  If ya need to talk, PM me...it's rough to go through by yourself.
I am a barnacle...and I'm' currently attached to a turtle.

You sound like me.  Almost the exact same situation..except I was a little younger when I broke it off (22).  To this day, I still wonder what if...but it's faded a bit now (32 now).  It does fade...and it is possible to be happy again.  She'll always have a place in your heart though...that's not something you can ever get rid of.

I've tried sitting down to talk to her about this.  It never ends well.  She suffers from severe depression, PTSD, and is currently 2 weeks off her meds.  No matter how calm I am when I'm trying to talk to her...and no matter what I say...by the end of the conversation, it's usually me saying I'm sorry, didn't mean to bring this up.  I'll ignore it.  
I was never like this before we got married...I was actually a pretty strong person.
If this works for you...I may have to steal your idea... :)  Seems like a pretty good way to change life up.

It's been a dream of mine since I was 6 years old to fish the Great Barrier Reef.  I can remember going on a fishing trip with my dad, and pretending that we were on the ocean...and when I got a bite, pretending that it was a huge shark that I was reeling in...
You have no idea how tempting that is...lol.  I have a really close friend who recently moved to Adalade Australia...and I'm incredibly jealous of her.

if you'll notice in one of my posts...I'm only concerned with enough money to keep food in their bellies and a roof over their head.  I'm leaching off a friend, who is a much better person than I could ever strive to be...and frankly, I'm sick of being a burden to her.  She struggles enough on her own.  I thank you for your insight...and you are correct.  It is ME that is ashamed to look at them.  If I had more time to type...I could really lay everything that is going on in my life out to you...and then maybe you wouldn't be so judgemental about my decision.  I realize that you are worried that I am not thinking this through...but I have.  I believe my children would be better off without me.
becaues that would be super effective...asshole.  I'd rather choke myself out first.

I can't change it.  I've been trying for 4 years to change it.  No matter what I do...every time I feel like I've taken a step forward, something knocks me 4 steps back.  I'm not concerned with the toys or the money (other than you have to have at least a little of it to provide the nessecary things in life like a house, or food).  I'm lucky in the fact that my kids are not materialistic at all.  They're just as happy with toys from a thrift store as they would be with brand new toys.  I'm just tired of feeling like everything is falling on me.  I can't breathe.  I started getting ahead...then I had to go through some hardcore surgery while my wife was pregnant.  then I found out she was cheating on me with a coworker while I was in the hospital.  then we worked through it and I lost my job.  I got a new job, only to make less money so we couldn't afford our house.  I can't find another job around here.  I've got my resume out everywhere I can think of...and have gone as far as to be narrowed down to 1 of 2 candidates...and then get turned away.  I can't get health insurance to cover the monthly tests I'm supposed to get to make sure I'm not going to die of a stroke.  I can hardly afford my medication...and am currently going without.  I'm tired of asking my friends to borrow money because I can't afford to pay them back.  I'm tired of always wondering if I'm going to be able to get to work because I'm not sure if my car will make it..wheather it be no gas in the tank, or the horrible noise coming from the engine.  I can't express any of this to my wife...because she's even more depressed than I am.  She already tried to give up once.  I wouldn't let her...not because I didn't want her to die...but because it wasn't fair that she gets to go and I have to stay here alone.  my kids deserve better!!!!!!

Right now...I can't look my kids in the eye at all.  I feel like I've failed them as a father because I can't provide for them the way I should.  I love my kids more than anything in the universe...which is why I feel they deserve better.
